goal.title: 3 · Caps on names
goal.text:
A cap says what a name brick does: # stores a number, ~ looks it up, ; adds to it. Type x# or x~ and the cap appears on the brick.

Store 5 in x, add 3 to x, print x. Two columns read in order along the plate arrow.

steps.text: In the first column, type 5 then x#: # stores the number in x.
Start the next column with Ctrl+Enter: 3 then x; adds 3 to x.
A third column: x~ looks x up, > prints it.
Run it, then Check: columns run in the order the arrow shows.
